llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed cloud presentation-generation workflow that sends user-provided materials to its API only for the stated purpose and requires user review before final file generation.

dimensions.detail: The skill requires curl, an API key, network calls to the documented API base, and upload of user materials up to 10 MiB; this is sensitive but aligned with the cloud document-processing purpose and disclosed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation requires configuring PRESENTATION_GENERATION_API_KEY and restarting the OpenClaw gateway; this is disclosed and proportionate for an API-backed skill.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime rules constrain inputs, layouts, themes, edits, retries, citations, and delivery; generation is gated on user review and an explicit request to generate files.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No executable scripts, background services, local persistence hooks, privilege escalation, or tool hijacking were found. The artifacts state uploaded files and outputs are user-isolated and expire after seven days.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The described capability is coherent: inspect source materials, create a reviewable outline, then generate PPTX/PDF/PNG artifacts through the AI Skills platform.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that this skill uploads brief/document content to ai-skills.open-idea.net or a user-configured API base and uses a platform API key. Do not use it with documents you are not allowed to send to that service, and review the generated outline and final deck before sharing externally.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] unexpected: The Chinese-only documentation is a localization/accessibility limitation, but it does not show hidden behavior, privilege expansion, data misuse, or unsafe execution.
[E1] expected: The external POST request is the documented API call used to inspect presentation source material; it uses the configured bearer token and is consistent with the skill's stated cloud generation workflow.
[AIG-SARIF] expected: The static scan reported no results, and manual inspection found only Markdown instructions with no bundled executable payloads.
